text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"—The day before the Yayoi Sho. In 
Manhattan Cafe and Agnes Tachyon's shared 
classroom."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, anti-icing measures are completely 
set. To handle an even faster track...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
What's the matter, Cafe? Is that burning 
gaze a pre-heating for tomorrow, or 
perhaps...?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Why... did you tell me that you're running 
in the Yayoi Sho?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
It's not like you to come tell me 
something so unnecessary.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...Heheheh, "unnecessary," you say? Cafe, 
whether something is necessary to me or 
not is for me to decide, not you.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Tomorrow's Yayoi Sho is a race of even 
greater significance than the Satsuki Sho. 
To begin with, labels like GⅠ or GⅡ are 
merely external designations."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"To each individual, personal significance 
can outweigh general ratings! Crucial 
decisions often...!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, it just means it's an important 
race.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad. You made it in time. You got 
here much faster than I expected.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Tomorrow—show me who you are. Your 
present, and your future."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... I talked with Tachyon-san 
yesterday. About a lot of things...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...It's nothing. She doesn't speak in 
words that anyone other than herself could 
comprehend...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I've decided not to think about it. What's 
more important is...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Today's race will tell. Whether 
chasing after that person is the quickest 
shortcut to getting closer to my 
"friend"...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
That's why... I will push them to the 
limit. As far as I possibly can right now. 
...Please watch me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps due to brooding so deeply, her 
face looked quite haggard. That was just 
how serious Manhattan Cafe was.
